description.zh: 实例所在地域。>您可以调用[describeregions](~~196841~~)接口查看polardb-x支持的地域详情，包括地域id。
description.en: The region ID of the instance. > You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~196841~~) operation to query the regions supported by PolarDB-X, including region IDs.

descriptions.zh: 该接口用于获取用户账号下可用于实例专有网络（VPC）列表，以便在创建或管理数据库实例时选择合适的网络环境。
descriptions.en: Queries the list of Virtual Private Clouds (VPCs) available under your account for database instances. You can use this operation to select an appropriate network environment when creating or managing database instances.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun polardbx describe-rds-vpcs --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --zone-id cn-beijing-h --region cn-hangzhou
